place: Chaweng, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Off-Plan Three-Bedroom Hillside Pool Villa in Chaweng
blurb: An off-plan three-bedroom villa in a boutique two-villa development in the Chaweng hills, roughly 180 m above the sea with panoramic island and Gulf views. The structure is already complete, with around nine months to handover — time to finish the interiors to your own taste. Private 8 × 3 m pool, floor-to-ceiling glass and generous terraces, on its own freehold plot. ฿23,900,000.
detail:
The second of two private villas in a boutique hillside development above Chaweng, this three-bedroom home sits roughly 180 metres above sea level, oriented for a panoramic sweep across the island and the Gulf of Thailand. Designed to pair clean European architecture with an Asian minimalism of warm materials and tropical openness, it is a quiet, elevated retreat within easy reach of Chaweng's beaches and restaurants.

Across two floors and a separate master pavilion, an open-plan living and kitchen area opens through floor-to-ceiling glass to wide terraces and the pool. Three bedrooms include a master pavilion with its own en-suite and direct access to the terrace and pool, while the panoramic terraces — around 100 m² in total — extend the living space outdoors.

Outside are a private 8 × 3 m pool and covered parking, with services built for hillside self-sufficiency: a grid-connected solar option, EV-charging provision, a private 220 m deep well and a rainwater-collection system.

The villa's structure and shell are already built, with roughly nine months remaining to completion — so a buyer can still influence the interior finishes and specification. It occupies its own 600 m² freehold plot, with about 195 m² of interior space within some 380 m² of total built area, and is available freehold through a Thai company structure or on a registered leasehold. The completed two-bedroom-plus-office villa alongside is available separately. The images shown are the architect's renderings; floor plans, specification and a construction timeline are available on request.
